scope: Mathematical CFA highlight reconstruction and functional macOS qualification. No measured physical camera colour accuracy.
policy: Exact code ceiling only; 6x6 local planes; 32 cells, eight rays; two coherent seed cells; per-channel complete connected clipping regions; no neutral fallback; preserve valid samples and unsupported regions. Edge fits overlap within active area. Nikon digital ceiling distinct from nominal white; owned CLP1 DNGPrivateData for repack.

frozen_implementation_and_generator.policy: Exact code ceiling only; 6x6 local planes; 32 cells, eight rays; two coherent seed cells; per-channel complete connected clipping regions; no neutral fallback; preserve valid samples and unsupported regions. Edge fits overlap within active area. Nikon digital ceiling distinct from nominal white; owned CLP1 DNGPrivateData for repack.

development.scope: Known mathematical model. The compatibility matrices generate the input as well as interpreting it; these results do not measure physical camera accuracy. Clipped cases retain linear errors and are excluded from the main Lab score. No exposure fitting.

validation.scope: Known mathematical model. The compatibility matrices generate the input as well as interpreting it; these results do not measure physical camera accuracy. Clipped cases retain linear errors and are excluded from the main Lab score. No exposure fitting.

timing.scope: Three D750 files, three warmups, thirty timed decodes per engine/file, alternating engine order. Hashing/metrics excluded from timer; input hashing/IPC included. No concurrent qualification workload, no controlled thermal/cold-start/RSS qualification.

new_clipping_metadata.purpose: Preserve Nikon digital ceiling separately from nominal white during lossless DNG repack; original sensor codes retained.
new_clipping_metadata.limits: Not a measured saturation calibration. Only uint16 domain without LUT; unknown/inconsistent owned records rejected. Other engines can ignore it.

development_findings: The first local estimator produced support gaps near corners and larger gradient errors. Two source cells per ray, complete-region admission and active-edge fits replace that proposal.

The final held-out set was generated after freezing source and generator hashes. It changes illuminant, colours, dimensions, noise and X-Trans phases; it is not a physically calibrated or blind camera study.
limits: Both patches per scene overlap and CFA phases are related; these are deterministic model checks, not independent photographic population samples.
Compatibility matrices also generate the forward data. D750/D800/X-T5 model coefficients and CFA layouts do not establish their physical accuracy. D850 and deferred compatibility work are unchanged.

The old 208 scenes, including the clipped-neutral step chart, remain identical. The new estimator rejects abrupt intensity boundaries or insufficient complete-region support rather than assuming white.
The legacy engine still has lower errors in some noisy neutral, edge and fully clipped cases. It remains available; overall superiority is not established.
Real available files lack eligible complete-region support and remain unchanged; no physical highlight improvement is claimed for those photographs.
Exact code ceilings miss physical clipping plateaus below the digital/declared level; measured sensor saturation thresholds and calibrated targets remain needed.
No gate R0-R4/SF is closed, and ad hoc signatures/RSS supervision are not release guarantees.
